name: GT 720p + RAM recovery (experimental)
description: Keeps the exact-01.010 native eboot display-target patch and additionally scales Vulkan render-target backing to one third, so a game-created 3840x2160 video-out image uses about 1280x720 backing (the original native patch alone left 4K images). Includes this branch's image eviction and 32 MiB VMA allocation policy. Game render-path quality and device stability must be verified on hardware; this is not a confirmed native internal 720p mode.
